title: Personal Checking: Overdraft Coverage Limits and Overdraft Item Fee Levels
content:
## Purpose

Personal Checking tiers differ in whether the bank will pay an item into overdraft at its discretion, how deep that overdraft may go, and what an overdraft costs. The table below sets those figures for every tier.

## Terms used in the table

- **Coverage offered** — whether the tier provides discretionary overdraft coverage at all. "No" means an item that would overdraw the account is declined or returned rather than paid.
- **Coverage limit (USD)** — the deepest point below zero to which PCB will take the ledger balance when it chooses to pay items that overdraw the account.
- **Fee per overdraft item (USD)** — the price of every item PCB chooses to pay although it overdraws the account.
- **Small-item threshold (USD)** — an item of this amount or less never draws an overdraft fee.
- **End-of-day threshold (USD)** — when a business day closes with the ledger overdrawn by no more than this amount, that day carries neither overdraft fees nor returned-item fees.
- **Daily fee count** — on any one business day, the ceiling on overdraft item and returned item charges an account can collect, the two kinds being counted as one pool.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coverage offered | Coverage limit | Fee per overdraft item | Small-item threshold | End-of-day threshold | Daily fee count |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | yes | 100.00 | 15.00 | 5.00 | 50.00 | 1 |
| Everyday Checking | yes | 500.00 | 35.00 | 5.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Interest Checking | yes | 750.00 | 35.00 | 5.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Premier Checking | yes | 1000.00 | 35.00 | 5.00 | 100.00 | 3 |
| Private Client Checking | yes | 2500.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 100.00 | 0 |

## Worked readings (hypothetical amounts)

- On Everyday Checking, a paid overdraft item of 4.75 USD sits below the 5.00 threshold and draws no fee; an item of exactly 5.00 also draws none, because the threshold includes its own amount; an item of 5.01 is above it.
- On Premier Checking, a business day that closes at negative 100.00 USD carries no overdraft or returned-item fee; a day closing at negative 100.01 is beyond the threshold.
- Private Client Checking pays into overdraft up to 2500.00 USD but prices each such item at 0.00.
